record: syzygy-bpyt.16: the code-context mask ends a line at CRLF, CR and LF

authority.authorized: Inside maskMarkdownCodeContexts a line ends at CRLF, CR or LF. The split keeps every terminator and offset. A CRLF or CR text gets exactly the decision its LF form gets.
notAuthorized: any specification or policy byte (the PWB-REQ-006 clarifying sentence was not chosen)
the extraction, index-link and consent readers (G2, G3 and G4 of the fence-rule record stay open owner questions)
any change to how an LF text is read
normalizing the text at the scanner entry, which would renumber findings in a bare-CR file

subject.note: The record is committed after the code commit. The code commit is the subject of every measurement here; the PR head adds only this directory.

builtModule.what: sha256 of dist/markdown-code-context.js, each built with tsc -b in its own checkout

ccRev1Classes.class4: security: the mask decides which text the active-content scan (SEC-3 untrusted-content gate) reads; scanActiveContent is the only caller
ccRev1Classes.class3: deterministic observation: the same bytes now give one admit/refuse decision whatever their line terminator

notClaimed.class1: authority boundaries: body-read-authority, the write-universe and the typed-authority table are untouched

ccRev1Classes.rule: Class membership is never finally determined by the agent performing the change; a reviewer or the owner may reclassify.

vetPackage.what: the files of the V-CRLF-MASK-1 vet (verdict REPRODUCED at 8ff50172) copied byte for byte: its corpus, runner, mutant runner, pin tests, prototype diff and result files

rawReview.name: V-CRLF-MASK-1-RAW.md
rawReview.why: the raw quotes an act argument, which check_governance CG-7e accepts only in a file under the raw-review lane (docs/reviews, a -RAW.md name) or in a registered copy, and a file in that lane needs a campaign pattern and a docs/README.md row, the shared count that one integration edit per batch of raws changes; the coordinator retains it

corpora.readsNoRepository: every text is synthetic, written in the corpus files named here

meaning.C1: every LF text decides identically at BASE and HEAD: findings and mask deep-equal
meaning.C2: at HEAD every CRLF, CR and mixed rendering decides as its LF form: same finding multiset (form, context, malformed line), equal mask once terminators read as LF
meaning.C3: at HEAD the masked text has the text length, every terminator at its offset, every other byte its own or a space
meaning.C4: at HEAD a CRLF text has findings deep-equal to its LF form, line and column included

differential.anyOtherDifference: none: every check above has 0 failures; a failure would have stopped the work

positionOf.note: positionOf counts LF only (unchanged by the fix): rows whose non-malformed findings sit at another line or column than the LF form, mixed and bare-CR renderings

acceptRefuseDelta.definition: BASE and HEAD each decide the same CRLF, CR or mixed text; refuses = BASE admits and HEAD excludes (a fail-open closed); accepts = BASE excludes and HEAD admits (a fail-closed reading the LF form admits); the others keep their decision

vetCorpus.vetBaseSummary: vet-v-crlf-mask-1/summary.json, the vet run over the BASE build, holds the same 32/48, 32/44 and 4/44 (controls 7/5, 7/3, 1/9)

secondMethod.what: the vet runner (vet-v-crlf-mask-1/tools/run.mjs, unchanged) over the HEAD build, with the vet independent oracle written from the PWB-REQ-006 bullets (CR read as a line terminator)

maskMutants.detectors: the seven test files this change adds or edits, one vitest run per mutant
maskMutants.equivalent: MU16: a line holds no CR or LF now (both are split points), so blanking by [^\n] and by length agree; no test can tell them apart

digestCitersSweep.population: 6064 tracked files at the population commit, excluding docs/evidence/syzygy-bpyt-6-3/
digestCitersSweep.reading: the base digest is cited only by retained review-measurement records of the fence-rule review (they name the file as it was then); no act, manifest, acceptance record or .syzygy or openspec file cites either digest

residuals: [Observed] positionOf in git-object-reader counts LF only and is unchanged (the ruling). A non-malformed finding in a bare-CR or mixed text keeps the LF-only line and column; a malformed finding takes the mask line, which now counts CR and CRLF as line ends. The differential counts those rows under positionOf.

[Observed] The extractor splits at LF and drops one trailing CR; the link reader splits at LF only. For a bare-CR text each differs from the profile (links in 30 of the 33 fence cases, extraction in all 33, pinned in fence-rules.test.ts rows named GAP G2/G3). They are open owner questions G2 and G3 and are not changed here.
[Observed] The consent reader (outsideFences) is unchanged and stays CR-blind (G4).
[Observed] docs/evidence/syzygy-bpyt-6-3/dc3-fence-rules-2026-10-25.json and its probe outputs record G1 as measured before this fix; they are not edited.
[Unknown] No Butlers body or other observed repository was read; the measurement is over synthetic corpora only, so how many real CRLF sources the exclusions change is Unknown.
